BiblicalUsage: The flowers appear on the earth, and the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in the land. One verse holds the whole spring of the Song — blossom, birdsong, and the turtledove.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the spring of the Song is the spring of love itself: the flowers appear, and the season of singing begins.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
